description: Fired when the user confirms the two-step Delete button. Persist with system.user.removeUser(userSource, event.username) and refresh the data.users binding. Capability flags only hide UI: a crafted client can send this event with any payload, so check the session user's roles and re-read the flags here on the gateway before writing (see the adminAuth reference library).

username.description: Username of the user to delete.
